0: Units with this ability can capture villages.
1: Units with this ability gain 10 attack/defence bonus when in water.
10: Units with this ability can repair ruined villages.
11: For units who have this ability, tombstones will not appear on the map when they die. Moreover, when they are [Poisoned] they can still receive heals from terrains and the poison damages will become heals. However heals from allies will become damages to them.
12: For units who have this ability, they gain 15 attack bonus when attacking enemies with ability [Air Force].
13: Units with this ability can move through water terrains using 1 movement point, and when they are on water they gain 10 health recovery at turn start.
14: Units with this ability can move through forest terrains using 1 movement point, and when they are in forest they gain 10 health recovery at turn start.
15: Units with this ability can move through mountain terrains using 1 movement point, and when they are in mountain they gain 10 health recovery at turn start.
16: Units with this ability can move through land terrains using 1 movement point.
17: For units who have this ability, when they standby they will attach [Slowed] status to enemies within 2 blocks for 1 turn. However units with this ability will not affect each other.
18: Units with this ability can capture castles.
19: Units with this ability cannot take action when moved and status cannot be attached to them.
2: Units with this ability gain 10 attack/defence bonus when in forest.
20: For units who have this ability, when they standby they will attach [Inspired] status to allies within 2 blocks for current turn.
21: For units who have this ability, each enemy within 2 blocks will give 10 attack bonus and 5 physical defence bonus to them, but they cannot receive heals from terrains.
22: For units who have this ability, when on ally villages or castles, they will gain 5 defence bonus.
23: For units who have this ability, when they standby they will clear debuff of allies within 2 blocks and heal them a bit. The healing amount will increase when leveling up.
24: For units who have this ability, their melee attacks will be 1.5 times stronger.
25: For units who have this ability, if the attacker is within 2 blocks away they can perform counter attacks.
26: For units who have this ability, their attacks will attach [Blinded] status to enemies. However units with this ability will not affect each other.
27: Units with this ability will recover 25% max HP at turn start, regardless of being [Poisoned] or not.
28: For units who have this ability, they receive 50% less damage from ranged attacks.
29: Not part of the original game - added for this port's Druid. Units with this ability can reactivate an ally that has already gone standby this turn, resetting that ally's movement fully and letting it act again. The target can't already be a Charger or Commander, and can't be a higher level than the supporting unit.
3: Units with this ability gain 10 attack/defence bonus when in mountain.
4: Units with this ability can destroy villages.
5: Units with this ability can move through all terrains using 1 movement point, and can move through ground enemy units. But they will not receive defence bonuses from terrains.
6: Necromancers can summon skeletons from fallen units, at the same time they will not be [Poisoned] if they standby on tombstones.
7: Units with this ability can heal allies, and the healing amount will increase when leveling up. Note that healer's heal can exceed target's HP cap once.
8: For units who have this ability, once they finished their actions they can use their remaining movement points to move again.
9: For units who have this ability, their attacks will attach [Poisoned] status to enemies for 2 turns. However units with this ability will not affect each other.
